title_o: Identifying maltreatment subgroups with patterns of maltreatment subtype and chronicity: A latent class analysis approach

replications.quote: Results provide evidence for the replication of four unique latent classes of CM exposure: a) nonmaltreated, b) Episodic, Single-Type (Neglect), c) Episodic, Single-Type (Abuse), d) Chronic, Multi-Type.
